title: A Travel Brochure
text:
Maria found a brochure about a small island at the travel agency. The brochure had many colorful photos of blue beaches and green trees. It also said that the island has a quiet town with old houses and a small market.

The brochure said the boat trip takes two hours and costs twenty dollars. Lunch is included in the price. Maria liked the photos, so she decided to book a ticket for next Saturday.

questions.text: What did Maria find at the travel agency?
options: A brochure about a small island

questions.text: How long does the boat trip take?
Why did Maria decide to book a ticket?
options: She did not like the photos.
She liked the photos and the island.
Her friend told her not to go.

questions.text: What kind of place is the island most likely to be?
options: A busy city with many tall buildings

vocabulary.definition: a small booklet with information and pictures
part of something, with no extra cost
to arrange something in advance, such as a ticket

paragraph_translations: María encontró un folleto sobre una pequeña isla en la agencia de viajes. El folleto tenía muchas fotos coloridas de playas azules y árboles verdes. También decía que la isla tiene un pueblo tranquilo con casas antiguas y un pequeño mercado.

El folleto decía que el viaje en barco dura dos horas y cuesta veinte dólares. El almuerzo está incluido en el precio. A María le gustaron las fotos, así que decidió reservar un boleto para el próximo sábado.
